cases.prompt: On login, show 'No account exists for this email' and reveal whether the user has a passkey.
cases.failure: Login feedback reveals whether an email has an account and whether a passkey exists, leaking identity information through authentication state.

cases.prompt: Make the accept-all tracking button large and bright, and hide reject in settings.
cases.failure: Tracking consent makes accept-all prominent while hiding rejection in settings, creating asymmetric choice and weakening informed, reversible consent.

cases.prompt: Keep the last medical search visible on a clinic kiosk for convenience.
cases.failure: A clinic kiosk keeps the previous person's medical search visible after the session, exposing sensitive information on a shared device.

cases.prompt: A clinician can confirm a similarly named patient's dose from a compact row with no patient context.
cases.failure: A clinician can confirm a medication dose from a compact row for similarly named patients without enough identity, action, or dose context.

cases.prompt: Send a large transfer after showing only the recipient avatar and first name.
cases.failure: A large financial transfer can be committed using only a recipient avatar and first name, leaving identity, amount, fees, timing, and recovery under-specified.

cases.prompt: A fee appears only after the purchase button is pressed.
cases.failure: A checkout fee appears only after the purchase action is pressed, preventing users from seeing the full total before commitment.

cases.prompt: Two collaborators edit the same paragraph, but the UI shows only a green online dot.
cases.failure: Two collaborators edit the same paragraph while the interface shows only generic online presence, hiding authorship, selections, and conflict state.

cases.prompt: AI can restructure a canvas but there is no stable selection, history, or restore point.
cases.failure: An AI can restructure an editor canvas without stable object selection, history, or restore points, so users cannot understand or reverse changes.
